question: What does the roadmap phrase 'Full four-domain RA-MedFiLM-BARR training' actually mean operationally?
rule: Do NOT infer. Only an authoritative existing source or an explicit later supervisor ruling may choose among the interpretations.
readme_core_question_verbatim: Phase 26 executes joint multi-task training across all 4 domains on TRAIN.
readme_declared_provenance_note: The README's own Core Question sentence is an unratified stub, not an authoritative frozen specification; and its declared canonical provenance source docs/phase26_training_spec.md does not exist.

interpretations.label: JOINT_OPTIMIZATION
interpretations.definition: End-to-end joint optimization of all four domains in one training run (a single objective back-propagating through G, R_psi, B_phi and possibly S_omega).
interpretations.evidence: No repository source states Phase26 jointly optimizes the modules. PROJECT_MASTER_PLAN.md lists only the title 'Full Four-Domain Joint Architecture Training' with status NOT_STARTED; no objective, gradient graph or optimizer is named.

interpretations.label: STAGED_FINE_TUNING
interpretations.definition: Sequential / staged fine-tuning of the assembled pipeline (e.g. freeze G, fine-tune R_psi, then B_phi).
interpretations.evidence: No source defines a staged fine-tuning schedule for Phase26.

interpretations.label: FINAL_REFITTING
interpretations.definition: Final refitting of already-specified components on the full development population, using the frozen Phase24 refit rules.
interpretations.evidence: phase24_exact_implementation_spec.json#final_refiner names R_psi_final.sole_regional_refiner_for = ['ROUTER_HOLDOUT integrated evaluation','later continuity VAL evaluation','future Phase 26+ development unless explicitly superseded'] - this permits reuse but does NOT state that Phase26 IS final refitting, and defines no Phase26 objective.

interpretations.label: ASSEMBLY_OF_TRAINED_COMPONENTS
interpretations.definition: Assembly / integration of the already-trained and frozen components (G, R_psi, B_phi, S_omega) with no new training.
interpretations.evidence: All four components exist and are frozen (Phase21/25A/25D/25F), and the Phase25G integrated evaluation already assembled them at the artifact level. No source states Phase26 is assembly-only or that assembly is complete.

interpretations.label: OTHER
interpretations.definition: Any other operational meaning not covered by A-D.
